title: Special Project
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office returns from various personal events, including Pam and Angela coming back to work, and discusses a trip to Florida, with tensions over team selection and individual motivations. Dwight opposes Erin going to Florida and plans a new Sabre retail store. Jim receives an invitation from RC to go to Tallahassee, and Jim and Pam prepare for his upcoming trip, while office members express their desires and frustrations regarding the trip and personal relationships.

main_threads.thread: Office plans and conflicts over the Florida trip, including team selection and individual motivations.
